errors.text_span: В диаграмата са включени четири категории, всяка обозначена с различен цвят: син за „Под 1 година“ (13,6%), оранжев за „От 1 до 5 години“ (18,2%), златист за „От 6 до 15 години“ (36,4%) и тъмнозелен за „От 16 до 30 години“ (31,8%).
errors.evidence: The description completely scrambles the mapping of categories, colors, and percentages. For example, the red slice ("Над 1 до 5 години") is 13.6%, not blue and "Под 1 година". The orange slice ("От 6 до 15 години") is 36.4%, but the description assigns "От 1 до 5 години" and 18.2% to the orange color. The category "Над 31 години" (purple, 31.8%) is completely omitted.

The description omits one of the largest categories shown in the chart: the purple slice representing "Над 31 години" with 31.8% of the responses. It also incorrectly states there are four categories in total, while the legend lists five (one of which has a 0% share).
The description incorrectly states that there is no legend, but a legend is clearly visible on the right side of the chart, listing five categories and their corresponding colors.

errors.text_span: Няма... етикети с проценти, включени в секторите, но процентите за всеки сектор са изписани извън самата диаграма.
errors.evidence: This statement is entirely false. The chart clearly shows percentage labels inside each of the four visible slices. The percentages are not written outside the diagram.

errors.text_span: Визуално сегментите са подредени по низходящ размер
errors.evidence: The segments are not ordered by size in either ascending or descending fashion. The values, in clockwise order starting from the largest slice, are 36.4%, 13.6%, 31.8%, and 18.2%, which is not a sorted sequence.
The description uses the label "От 1 до 5 години" (From 1 to 5 years), whereas the actual label in the legend is "Над 1 до 5 години" (Over 1 to 5 years).
